RecordGroup.Name: RG_FIND
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, iban || ' ' || holder text, product from bk_loan_v order by id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_LPAY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select a.id, a.iban || ' ' || a.holder || ' ' || a.currency text from bk_account_v a, bk_product p where a.status = 'O' and p.code = a.product and p.kind not in ('CC', 'LN') order by a.id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_LNPROD
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, name from bk_product where kind = 'LN' and active = 'Y' order by id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PMODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select 'T' code, bk_text.t('T10697459') descr, 0 o from dual union all select 'P' code, bk_text.t('TA62669AC') descr, 1 o from dual order by 3
